name: Pagae
text: Pagae or Pagai (; Doric Greek: Παγαί), or Pegae or Pegai (Ancient Greek: Πηγαί) was a town of ancient Megaris, on the Alcyonian or Corinthian Gulf. According to some sources of greek mythology Pagae had been the home town of Tereus. It was the harbour of Megaris on the western coast, and was the most important place in the country next to the capital.

depictions.text: Pagae Pagai was an ancient Greek harbour in Megaris on the Korinthian Gulf, serving as a port town for Megara.
